reason: The text is a narrative account of the tenth plague (death of the firstborn) and the Exodus from Egypt. While it depicts Pharaoh (an elite figure) making poor decisions by resisting God's will, the passage does not make a general statement comparing the intelligence or wisdom of regular people to the elite. The narrative focuses on divine intervention, Pharaoh's stubbornness/spiritual blindness, and the liberation of the Israelites, rather than on any commentary about intelligence distribution across social classes.
